layers: Supervised RoCEnante peer waits: waiting kernels read a host abort word every 1,024 polls, and the proxy thread stops a wait only when a peer is unreachable, sends a stop notice or reports an inconsistent sequence, or after B12X_ROCE_PEER_TIMEOUT_S (300 s by default); it then notifies every peer, and it logs each wait longer than 5 s with the flags still missing (runtime/images/derive_transport_peer_wait.py, FujitsuPolycom/sparkring#278). Proxy ABI 5: ranks of this image and of its parent refuse to connect to each other. /opt/sparkring/receipts/derived-transport-peer-wait.json records the six replaced transport files and the replaced bundle manifest

qualification_scope: Development image. Registry verification does not establish serving correctness; each profile states its own evidence scope.
